claims.statement: For every homogeneous arity-2 path-star profile with m>=1, N=2m, Q=(1+3z+z^2)^m, C=(1+2z)Q, and E=z(1+z)^(2m), the shifted E minor M_k(E)=E[k]C[k]-E[k+1]C[k-1] is strictly positive at k=m+1, with M_(m+1)(E)/binom(2m,m)=((m+2)Q[m]-(m-1)Q[m-1])/(m+1)>0. This is a component/rank lemma only.
claims.scope: Homogeneous arity-2 profiles, rank k=m+1 only; this is the outer boundary 2k=N+2. No actual first descent x or eligibility guards x+2<=p, 3p<2alpha+1, 2p<=alpha are hypotheses; no current-p strict selectors e0,ei or original-tag weighted selected sum occur. It does not cover other guarded ranks, mixed profiles, the exact-ratio payment, selected MASS, or aggregate.
claims.reason: Palindromicity gives Q[m+1]=Q[m-1]; direct coefficient substitution yields the claimed identity. Positive-interval log-concavity of Q and symmetry imply Q[m]>=Q[m-1]>0, so the numerator equals 3Q[m]+(m-1)(Q[m]-Q[m-1])>0. Positive denominators preserve the sign. Independent monomial-z integer convolution cross-checks m=1..8; those checks are bounded evidence, while the argument is universal.

limitations: The review retains one homogeneous-arity-2 E-component minor at one rank and does not establish the full E-only condition, selected payment, selected MASS, or aggregate.
The finite script checks m=1..8 only; no census, Lean build, producer-script execution, or formal award was performed.
All conclusions are proposed worker dispositions; status_authority is proposed_worker_only.
